chapter.title: Styling and icons
chapter.lede: `std/tw` writes the theme's utility stylesheet at build time. `std/icons` turns a pinned icon collection into an import, so a glyph is checked like a name.

sections.heading: Utility classes
prose: std/tw is a generator: it compiles the theme — spacing, color, breakpoints — into one stylesheet at build time. Nothing is fetched at runtime. The whole vocabulary ships, used or not; per-template pruning is a recorded gap, not a feature this page may claim.

sections.heading: Icons
prose: std/icons makes a glyph a name: import { book } from icons("bytesize", "book") generates one function per glyph from a collection pinned in the lock file. A name the collection does not have fails the build. The <Icon> tag draws them.
